I fixed the regression and committed it as `5bdde1e9d5c6`. The 104 cases from your list now pass, and so do this ticket's 179 acceptance tests.

The cause: the hook imported `cto_install` together with the rest of the install rule. The tests run the hook under the installed, pinned `gov`, which is older and has no `cto_install`. The import failed, so the hook ended with exit 2 on every Bash call, installs or not. Now the hook imports `cto_install` only when an install reaches the CTO check. If it can't be imported, the install is refused with a stated reason and every other call is decided as before.
